title: Identity Abuse and Lateral Movement
story: The SOC observed administrative authentication activity across several internal systems. Some of the activity belongs to legitimate IT personnel, while other sessions may represent malicious use of stolen credentials. Determine whether the attacker moved laterally and reconstruct the pivot path.
objective: Correlate authentication events, network connections and endpoint activity to distinguish legitimate administrator behaviour from malicious lateral movement.

questions.label: Which account was abused for lateral movement?
Identify the first compromised internal host
Identify the host used as the pivot point
Identify the final lateral movement target
Which service was primarily used for lateral movement?
